source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §1 — signs in general

en.question: What is the main purpose of a regulatory road sign?
options: To regulate or control what road users may or must do
To advertise nearby businesses
To show only tourist attractions
en.explanation: Regulatory signs control road-user actions by prohibiting or commanding specific behaviour.

af.question: Wat is die hoofdoel van 'n regulatoriese padteken?
options: Om te reguleer of te beheer wat padgebruikers mag of moet doen
Om nabygeleë besighede te adverteer
Om slegs toeriste-aantreklikhede aan te dui
af.explanation: Regulatoriese tekens beheer padgebruikers se optrede deur sekere gedrag te verbied of voor te skryf.

xh.question: Yintoni eyona njongo iphambili yophawu lwendlela olumiselayo?
options: Ukulawula oko abasebenzisi bendlela abanokukwenza okanye ekufuneka bekwenzile
Ukubhengeza amashishini akufuphi
Ukubonisa kuphela iindawo zabakhenkethi
xh.explanation: Iimpawu ezimiselayo zilawula izenzo zabasebenzisi bendlela ngokuthintela okanye ngokuyalela indlela ethile yokuziphatha.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §1 — ordinary sign shapes

en.question: What is the ordinary shape of most warning signs?
options: Triangular
Round
Rectangular
en.explanation: Warning signs are ordinarily triangular and alert road users to hazards or dangerous conditions.

af.question: Wat is die gewone vorm van die meeste waarskuwingstekens?
options: Driehoekig
Rond
Reghoekig
af.explanation: Waarskuwingstekens is gewoonlik driehoekig en waarsku padgebruikers teen gevare of gevaarlike toestande.

xh.question: Yeyiphi imilo eqhelekileyo yeempawu ezininzi zesilumkiso?
options: Unxantathu
Isangqa
Uxande
xh.explanation: Iimpawu zesilumkiso zidla ngokuba ngoonxantathu kwaye zilumkisa abasebenzisi bendlela ngeengozi okanye iimeko ezinobungozi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §1 — ordinary sign shapes

en.question: What is the ordinary shape of guidance signs?
options: Rectangular
Triangular
Octagonal
en.explanation: Guidance signs are ordinarily rectangular and help road users with direction and route guidance.

af.question: Wat is die gewone vorm van rigting- en leidingstekens?
options: Reghoekig
Driehoekig
Agthoekig
af.explanation: Leidingstekens is gewoonlik reghoekig en help padgebruikers met rigting en roeteleiding.

xh.question: Yeyiphi imilo eqhelekileyo yeempawu zesikhokelo?
options: Uxande
Unxantathu
Unxantathu onamacala asibhozo
xh.explanation: Iimpawu zesikhokelo zidla ngokuba luxande kwaye zinceda abasebenzisi bendlela ngolwalathiso nendlela emayilandelwe.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.1 — Stop sign R1.1

en.question: What must you do at a STOP sign when a stop line is marked?
options: Stop behind the stop line
Slow down and continue if the road looks clear
Stop only if another vehicle is coming
en.explanation: At a STOP sign you must bring the vehicle to a complete stop behind the stop line and proceed only when it is safe.

af.question: Wat moet jy by 'n STOP-teken doen wanneer 'n stoplyn gemerk is?
options: Stop agter die stoplyn
Verminder spoed en ry voort as die pad oop lyk
Stop slegs as 'n ander voertuig aankom
af.explanation: By 'n STOP-teken moet jy die voertuig heeltemal agter die stoplyn tot stilstand bring en eers voortgaan wanneer dit veilig is.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kuphawu lwe-STOP xa kukho umgca wokuma?
options: Yima emva komgca wokuma
Cotha uze uqhubeke ukuba indlela ibonakala icacile
Yima kuphela xa kukho esinye isithuthi esiza
xh.explanation: Kuphawo lwe-STOP kufuneka umise isithuthi ngokupheleleyo emva komgca wokuma uze uqhubeke kuphela xa kukhuselekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.1 — Stop sign R1.1

en.question: At a STOP sign with no stop line, where should the front of the vehicle come to a standstill?
options: In line with the STOP sign
Ten metres before the sign
After entering the intersection
en.explanation: If there is no stop line, the front of the vehicle should stop in line with the STOP sign.

af.question: By 'n STOP-teken sonder 'n stoplyn, waar moet die voorkant van die voertuig tot stilstand kom?
options: In lyn met die STOP-teken
Tien meter voor die teken
Nadat jy die kruising binnegegaan het
af.explanation: As daar geen stoplyn is nie, moet die voorkant van die voertuig in lyn met die STOP-teken stop.

xh.question: Kuphawo lwe-STOP olungenamgca wokuma, umphambili wesithuthi kufuneka ume phi?
options: Ulingane nophawu lwe-STOP
Iimitha ezilishumi phambi kophawu
Emva kokungena esiphambanweni
xh.explanation: Ukuba akukho mgca wokuma, umphambili wesithuthi kufuneka ume ulingane nophawu lwe-STOP.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §7.1 — Stop line RTM1

en.question: What does a stop line mean if there is no STOP sign next to it?
options: It still requires you to stop
It only marks a parking area
It may be ignored if traffic is light
en.explanation: A stop line has the same stop requirement even when no STOP sign is present.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n stoplyn as daar geen STOP-teken langsaan is nie?
options: Dit vereis steeds dat jy stop
Dit merk slegs 'n parkeergebied
Dit kan geïgnoreer word as verkeer min is
af.explanation: 'n Stoplyn vereis steeds dat jy stop, selfs wanneer daar geen STOP-teken is nie.

xh.question: Uthetha ukuthini umgca wokuma xa kungekho phawu lwe-STOP ecaleni kwawo?
options: Usafuna ukuba ume
Ubonisa kuphela indawo yokupaka
Ungawuhoya xa izithuthi zimbalwa
xh.explanation: Umgca wokuma usafuna ukuba ume nangona kungekho phawu lwe-STOP.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §7.1 — Yield line RTM2

en.question: What should you do at a yield line?
options: Give priority to traffic crossing your path
Always stop for at least five seconds
Accelerate before entering the intersection
en.explanation: A yield line means you must give way to road users crossing or wanting to cross your path.

af.question: Wat moet jy by 'n toegeelyn doen?
options: Voorrang gee aan verkeer wat jou pad kruis
Altyd vir minstens vyf sekondes stop
Versnel voordat jy die kruising binnegaan
af.explanation: 'n Toegeelyn beteken jy moet padgee aan padgebruikers wat jou pad kruis of wil kruis.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kumgca wokunikezela indlela?
options: Nika indlela kwizithuthi eziwela indlela yakho
Soloko ume ubuncinane imizuzwana emihlanu
Khawulezisa phambi kokungena esiphambanweni
xh.explanation: Umgca wokunikezela indlela uthetha ukuba kufuneka unike indlela kubasebenzisi bendlela abawela okanye abafuna ukuwela indlela yakho.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §7.1 — Pedestrian crossing lines RTM3/RTM4

en.question: When pedestrians are crossing or waiting to cross at marked pedestrian crossing lines, what should a driver do?
options: Give them priority by slowing down or stopping
Sound the horn and continue
Drive around them if there is space
en.explanation: Marked pedestrian crossings require drivers to look out for pedestrians and give them priority.

af.question: Wanneer voetgangers by gemerkte voetoorganglyne oorsteek of wag om oor te steek, wat moet 'n bestuurder doen?
options: Gee hulle voorrang deur stadiger te ry of te stop
Toeter en ry voort
Ry om hulle as daar plek is
af.explanation: Gemerkte voetoorgange vereis dat bestuurders vir voetgangers uitkyk en aan hulle voorrang gee.

xh.question: Xa abahambi ngeenyawo bewela okanye belinde ukuwela kumgca ophawulweyo wabahambi ngeenyawo, kufuneka umqhubi enze ntoni?
options: Banike kuqala ngokucotha okanye ngokuma
Khalisa ixilongo uze uqhubeke
Bajikeleze ngemoto ukuba kukho indawo
xh.explanation: Iindawo eziphawulweyo zokuwela zabahambi ngeenyawo zifuna abaqhubi babajonge kwaye babanike kuqala.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §7.1 — No overtaking lines RM1

en.question: What is the main restriction of a no-overtaking line on a two-way road?
options: Do not drive with any part of your vehicle on the right-hand side of the line, except for limited permitted cases
You must drive exactly on the line
You may cross it whenever the road ahead looks clear
en.explanation: A no-overtaking line normally prohibits driving to the right of the line, with only limited exceptions such as certain direct-access or stationary-obstruction situations.

af.question: Wat is die hoofbeperking van 'n geen-verbysteeklyn op 'n tweerigtingpad?
options: Moenie met enige deel van jou voertuig regs van die lyn ry nie, behalwe in beperkte toegelate gevalle
Jy moet presies op die lyn ry
Jy mag dit oorsteek wanneer die pad voor jou oop lyk
af.explanation: 'n Geen-verbysteeklyn verbied jou normaalweg om regs van die lyn te ry, met slegs beperkte uitsonderings soos sekere direkte toegang of stilstaande versperrings.

xh.question: Yintoni eyona nto ithintelwa ngumgca ongavumeli ukudlula kwindlela enamacala amabini?
options: Musa ukuqhuba naliphi na icandelo lesithuthi sakho ngasekunene komgca, ngaphandle kweemeko ezithile ezivumelekileyo
Kufuneka uqhube kanye phezu komgca
Ungawuwela nanini na xa indlela engaphambili ibonakala icacile
xh.explanation: Umgca ongavumeli ukudlula udla ngokukuthintela ekuqhubeni ngasekunene kwawo, ngaphandle kweemeko ezimbalwa ezivumelekileyo ezifana nokungena ngqo okanye ukudlula umqobo omileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §8 — Traffic lights

en.question: What should you normally do when a traffic light turns amber?
options: Stop, unless stopping cannot be done safely
Speed up to cross before red
Treat it the same as a green light
en.explanation: Amber means stop, except where stopping cannot be done safely.

af.question: Wat moet jy normaalweg doen wanneer 'n verkeerslig amber word?
options: Stop, tensy dit nie veilig gedoen kan word nie
Versnel om oor te gaan voordat dit rooi word
Behandel dit dieselfde as 'n groen lig
af.explanation: Amber beteken stop, behalwe waar dit nie veilig moontlik is om te stop nie.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa irobhothi ijika ibe yi-amber?
options: Yima, ngaphandle kokuba ukumisa akunakwenziwa ngokukhuselekileyo
Khawulezisa ukuze uwelele phambi kokuba ibe bomvu
Yiphathe njengokukhanya okuluhlaza
xh.explanation: I-amber ithetha ukuba yima, ngaphandle kokuba ukumisa akunakwenziwa ngokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — No entry sign R3

en.question: What must you do when a No Entry sign applies to the road, carriageway or lane ahead?
options: Do not enter
Enter only if no traffic is coming
Enter slowly
en.explanation: A No Entry sign means traffic may not proceed past the sign into that road, carriageway or lane.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen wanneer 'n Geen Toegang-teken op die pad, rybaan of baan voor jou van toepassing is?
options: Moenie ingaan nie
Gaan net in as daar geen verkeer aankom nie
Gaan stadig in
af.explanation: 'n Geen Toegang-teken beteken dat verkeer nie verby die teken in daardie pad, rybaan of baan mag beweeg nie.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa uphawu oluthi Akungenwa lusebenza kwindlela okanye kumzila ongaphambili?
options: Musa ukungena
Ngena kuphela xa kungekho zithuthi zizayo
Ngena kancinci
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Akungenwa luthetha ukuba izithuthi azivumelekanga ukudlula kulo zingene kuloo ndlela okanye mzila.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Yield at traffic circle sign R2.2

en.question: What should you do when approaching a Yield at traffic circle sign?
options: Look for other vehicles, yield as required and stop if necessary
Speed up to enter before other traffic
Ignore vehicles already in the circle
en.explanation: At this sign you must look for other vehicles, yield to traffic with priority and stop if necessary.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen wanneer jy 'n Gee Pad by Verkeersirkel-teken nader?
options: Kyk vir ander voertuie, gee pad waar nodig en stop indien nodig
Versnel om voor ander verkeer in te gaan
Ignoreer voertuie wat reeds in die sirkel is
af.explanation: By hierdie teken moet jy vir ander voertuie uitkyk, aan verkeer met voorrang padgee en stop indien nodig.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa usondela kuphawu lokunika indlela kwisangqa sezithuthi?
options: Jonga ezinye izithuthi, nikezela indlela xa kufuneka uze ume xa kuyimfuneko
Khawulezisa ukuze ungene kuqala
Ungazihoyi izithuthi esele zikwisangqa
xh.explanation: Kolu phawu kufuneka ujonge ezinye izithuthi, unike indlela kwizithuthi ezinelungelo lokudlula kuqala uze ume xa kuyimfuneko.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Children warning sign W308/TW308

en.question: What action should you take when you see a Children warning sign?
options: Slow down and watch carefully for children
Increase speed to clear the area quickly
Use the horn continuously
en.explanation: The sign warns that children may cross unexpectedly, so slow down and watch carefully for them.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen wanneer jy 'n Waarskuwing vir Kinders-teken sien?
options: Verminder spoed en kyk versigtig uit vir kinders
Verhoog spoed om vinnig deur die gebied te beweeg
Gebruik die toeter aanhoudend
af.explanation: Die teken waarsku dat kinders onverwags kan oorsteek, daarom moet jy spoed verminder en versigtig vir hulle uitkyk.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa ubona uphawu olulumkisa ngabantwana?
options: Cotha uze ujonge abantwana ngononophelo
Nyusa isantya ukuze udlule ngokukhawuleza
Sebenzisa ihorn ngokuqhubekayo
xh.explanation: Uphawu lumkisa ukuba abantwana banokuwela ngendlela engalindelekanga, ngoko kufuneka ucothe uze ubajonge ngononophelo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Speed limit sign R201

en.question: What does a Speed Limit sign tell you?
options: The maximum speed permitted under that sign
The minimum speed you must travel
The recommended parking speed
en.explanation: A Speed Limit sign sets the maximum speed permitted while that restriction applies.

af.question: Wat sê 'n Spoedgrens-teken vir jou?
options: Die maksimum spoed wat onder daardie teken toegelaat word
Die minimum spoed waarteen jy moet ry
Die aanbevole parkeerspoed
af.explanation: 'n Spoedgrens-teken bepaal die maksimum spoed wat toegelaat word terwyl daardie beperking geld.

xh.question: Uphawu loMda weSantya lukuxelela ntoni?
options: Esona santya siphezulu sivumelekileyo phantsi kolo phawu
Esona santya sisezantsi omele uhambe ngaso
Isantya esicetyiswayo sokupaka
xh.explanation: Uphawu loMda weSantya lubeka esona santya siphezulu sivumelekileyo ngexesha olo thintelo lusebenza.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Parking prohibited sign R216

en.question: What does a Parking Prohibited sign mean?
options: You may not park where the restriction applies
You must stop and switch off the engine
You may park only on the sidewalk
en.explanation: A Parking Prohibited sign means parking is not allowed where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Parkering Verbode-teken?
options: Jy mag nie parkeer waar die beperking geld nie
Jy moet stop en die enjin afskakel
Jy mag net op die sypaadjie parkeer
af.explanation: 'n Parkering Verbode-teken beteken dat parkering nie toegelaat word waar die beperking geld nie.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Ukupaka Akuvumelekanga?
options: Akufanele upake apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Kufuneka ume uze ucime injini
Ungapaka kuphela kwindlela yabahambi ngeenyawo
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Ukupaka Akuvumelekanga luthetha ukuba ukupaka akuvumelekanga apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Stopping prohibited sign R217

en.question: What does a Stopping Prohibited sign mean?
options: You may not stop where the restriction applies
You may stop briefly but not park
You must stop before passing the sign
en.explanation: A Stopping Prohibited sign means stopping is not allowed where the restriction applies, except where the law provides an unavoidable exception.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Stop Verbode-teken?
options: Jy mag nie stop waar die beperking geld nie
Jy mag kortliks stop maar nie parkeer nie
Jy moet stop voordat jy die teken verbygaan
af.explanation: 'n Stop Verbode-teken beteken dat stop nie toegelaat word waar die beperking geld nie, behalwe waar die wet 'n onvermydelike uitsondering toelaat.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Ukuma Akuvumelekanga?
options: Akufanele ume apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Ungema ixesha elifutshane kodwa ungapaki
Kufuneka ume phambi kokudlula uphawu
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Ukuma Akuvumelekanga luthetha ukuba ukuma akuvumelekanga apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona, ngaphandle kweemeko ezingaphephekiyo ezivunyelwa ngumthetho.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — No U-turn regulatory sign R213

en.question: What does a No U-turn sign mean?
options: You may not make a U-turn where the restriction applies
You must make a U-turn
You may turn around only at night
en.explanation: A No U-turn sign prohibits making a U-turn where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Geen U-draai-teken?
options: Jy mag nie 'n U-draai maak waar die beperking geld nie
Jy moet 'n U-draai maak
Jy mag net snags omdraai
af.explanation: 'n Geen U-draai-teken verbied 'n U-draai waar die beperking geld.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Akukho U-jiko?
options: Akufanele wenze i-U-jiko apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Kufuneka wenze i-U-jiko
Ungajika ubuyele umva kuphela ebusuku
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Akukho U-jiko luthintela ukwenza i-U-jiko apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Proceed left only regulatory sign R105

en.question: What does a Proceed left only sign require you to do?
options: Proceed to the left only
Turn right only
Continue straight only
en.explanation: A Proceed left only sign requires traffic to proceed in the indicated left direction.

af.question: Wat vereis 'n Gaan Slegs Links-teken van jou?
options: Gaan slegs links
Draai slegs regs
Gaan slegs reguit aan
af.explanation: 'n Gaan Slegs Links-teken vereis dat verkeer in die aangeduide linkerrigting beweeg.

xh.question: Uphawu oluthi Qhubeka ngasekhohlo kuphela lufuna wenze ntoni?
options: Qhubeka ngasekhohlo kuphela
Jika ngasekunene kuphela
Qhubeka uye phambili kuphela
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Qhubeka ngasekhohlo kuphela lufuna izithuthi zihambe kwicala lasekhohlo elibonisiweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 — Turn right compulsory-direction regulatory sign R109

en.question: What does a Turn right sign require you to do?
options: Turn right as directed
Turn left as directed
Stop and wait for another vehicle
en.explanation: This compulsory-direction sign requires traffic to turn right as indicated.

af.question: Wat vereis 'n Draai Regs-teken van jou?
options: Draai regs soos aangedui
Draai links soos aangedui
Stop en wag vir 'n ander voertuig
af.explanation: Hierdie verpligte rigtingsteken vereis dat verkeer regs draai soos aangedui.

xh.question: Uphawu oluthi Jika ngasekunene lufuna wenze ntoni?
options: Jika ngasekunene njengoko kubonisiwe
Jika ngasekhohlo njengoko kubonisiwe
Yima uze ulinde esinye isithuthi
xh.explanation: Olu phawu lwendlela olunyanzelekileyo lufuna izithuthi zijike ngasekunene njengoko kubonisiwe.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.2 — Keep left sign R103

en.question: What does a Keep left sign require you to do?
options: Pass to the left of the obstruction
Pass to the right of the obstruction
Stop before the obstruction
en.explanation: The Keep left sign tells you to pass to the left of the obstruction where the sign is displayed.

af.question: Wat vereis 'n Hou Links-teken van jou?
options: Gaan links van die hindernis verby
Gaan regs van die hindernis verby
Stop voor die hindernis
af.explanation: Die Hou Links-teken sê jy moet links van die hindernis verbygaan waar die teken vertoon word.

xh.question: Uphawu oluthi Hlala ngasekhohlo lufuna wenze ntoni?
options: Dlula kwicala lasekhohlo lomqobo
Dlula kwicala lasekunene lomqobo
Yima phambi komqobo
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Hlala ngasekhohlo lukuxelela ukuba udlule kwicala lasekhohlo lomqobo apho uphawu luboniswe khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.2 — Proceed straight only sign R107

en.question: What does a Proceed straight only sign require you to do at the intersection?
options: Continue straight only
Turn left only
Turn right only
en.explanation: The sign requires traffic to proceed only in the direction shown by the arrow, which in this case is straight ahead.

af.question: Wat vereis 'n Gaan Slegs Reguit-teken van jou by die kruising?
options: Gaan slegs reguit aan
Draai slegs links
Draai slegs regs
af.explanation: Die teken vereis dat verkeer slegs in die rigting van die pyl beweeg, in hierdie geval reguit vorentoe.

xh.question: Uphawu oluthi Qhubeka ngqo kuphela lufuna wenze ntoni kwisiphambuka?
options: Qhubeka uye ngqo kuphela
Jika ngasekhohlo kuphela
Jika ngasekunene kuphela
xh.explanation: Uphawu lufuna izithuthi zihambe kuphela kwicala eliboniswe lutolo, kulo mzekelo ziye ngqo phambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.2 — Turn left only sign R108

en.question: What does a Turn left sign require you to do at the intersection ahead?
options: Turn left as directed
Turn right as directed
Continue straight only
en.explanation: This compulsory-direction sign requires traffic to turn left as indicated.

af.question: Wat vereis 'n Draai Links-teken van jou by die kruising vorentoe?
options: Draai links soos aangedui
Draai regs soos aangedui
Gaan slegs reguit aan
af.explanation: Hierdie verpligte rigtingsteken vereis dat verkeer links draai soos aangedui.

xh.question: Uphawu oluthi Jika ngasekhohlo lufuna wenze ntoni kwisiphambuka esingaphambili?
options: Jika ngasekhohlo njengoko kubonisiwe
Jika ngasekunene njengoko kubonisiwe
Qhubeka uye ngqo kuphela
xh.explanation: Olu phawu lwendlela olunyanzelekileyo lufuna izithuthi zijike ngasekhohlo njengoko kubonisiwe.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs v1.00 §3.1 — Yield sign R2

en.question: What must you do at a Yield sign when other traffic is approaching the intersection?
options: Reduce speed and stop if necessary
Accelerate through before the other traffic
Ignore the other traffic if you arrived first
en.explanation: At a Yield sign you must reduce speed and, if necessary, stop to yield to other traffic.

af.question: Wat moet jy by 'n Gee Pad-teken doen wanneer ander verkeer die kruising nader?
options: Verminder spoed en stop indien nodig
Versnel deur voordat die ander verkeer kom
Ignoreer die ander verkeer as jy eerste daar was
af.explanation: By 'n Gee Pad-teken moet jy spoed verminder en, indien nodig, stop om aan ander verkeer pad te gee.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kuphawu lokunika indlela xa ezinye izithuthi zisondela kwisiphambuka?
options: Cotha uze ume xa kuyimfuneko
Khawulezisa udlule phambi kwezinye izithuthi
Ungazihoyi ezinye izithuthi ukuba ufike kuqala
xh.explanation: Kuphawo lokunika indlela kufuneka unciphise isantya kwaye, xa kuyimfuneko, ume ukuze unike ezinye izithuthi indlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Left turn prohibited sign R211

en.question: What does a No Left Turn sign mean?
options: You may not turn left where the restriction applies
You must turn left
You may turn left only if no traffic is coming
en.explanation: A No Left Turn sign prohibits a left turn where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Geen Links Draai-teken?
options: Jy mag nie links draai waar die beperking geld nie
Jy moet links draai
Jy mag links draai as daar geen verkeer aankom nie
af.explanation: 'n Geen Links Draai-teken verbied 'n linksdraai waar die beperking geld.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Akukho Jiko ngasekhohlo?
options: Akufanele ujike ngasekhohlo apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Kufuneka ujike ngasekhohlo
Ungajika ngasekhohlo kuphela xa kungekho zithuthi zizayo
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Akukho Jiko ngasekhohlo luthintela ukujika ngasekhohlo apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Right turn prohibited sign R212

en.question: What does a No Right Turn sign mean?
options: You may not turn right where the restriction applies
You must turn right
You may turn right only after stopping
en.explanation: A No Right Turn sign prohibits a right turn where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Geen Regs Draai-teken?
options: Jy mag nie regs draai waar die beperking geld nie
Jy moet regs draai
Jy mag regs draai slegs nadat jy gestop het
af.explanation: 'n Geen Regs Draai-teken verbied 'n regsdraai waar die beperking geld.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Akukho Jiko ngasekunene?
options: Akufanele ujike ngasekunene apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Kufuneka ujike ngasekunene
Ungajika ngasekunene kuphela emva kokuma
xh.explanation: Uphawu oluthi Akukho Jiko ngasekunene luthintela ukujika ngasekunene apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — One-way roadway sign R4

en.question: What does a One-Way Roadway sign tell you?
options: Traffic using that roadway must proceed in the direction shown by the arrow
Traffic may travel in either direction
The road is closed to all vehicles
en.explanation: A One-Way Roadway sign indicates that the roadway carries traffic in the direction shown by the arrow.

af.question: Wat sê 'n Eenrigtingrybaan-teken vir jou?
options: Verkeer wat daardie rybaan gebruik moet in die rigting van die pyl beweeg
Verkeer mag in albei rigtings beweeg
Die pad is vir alle voertuie gesluit
af.explanation: 'n Eenrigtingrybaan-teken dui aan dat verkeer op daardie rybaan in die rigting van die pyl beweeg.

xh.question: Uphawu lweNdlela eNye kuphela lukuxelela ntoni?
options: Izithuthi ezisebenzisa loo ndlela kufuneka zihambe kwicala eliboniswe lutolo
Izithuthi zingahamba macala omabini
Indlela ivaliwe kuzo zonke izithuthi
xh.explanation: Uphawu lweNdlela eNye kuphela lubonisa ukuba izithuthi kuloo ndlela zihamba kwicala eliboniswe lutolo.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Pedestrian Priority sign R5

en.question: What is the main meaning of a Pedestrian Priority sign?
options: Pedestrians have priority in the indicated area
Vehicles always have priority over pedestrians
Pedestrians are prohibited from entering the area
en.explanation: A Pedestrian Priority sign gives priority to pedestrians in the indicated area and limits vehicle access.

af.question: Wat is die hoofbetekenis van 'n Voetgangerprioriteit-teken?
options: Voetgangers het voorrang in die aangeduide gebied
Voertuie het altyd voorrang bo voetgangers
Voetgangers mag nie die gebied betree nie
af.explanation: 'n Voetgangerprioriteit-teken gee voorrang aan voetgangers in die aangeduide gebied en beperk voertuigtoegang.

xh.question: Yintoni eyona ntsingiselo yophawu lweNgqwalaselo yabaHambi ngeenyawo?
options: Abahambi ngeenyawo banokubaluleka kuqala kwindawo ebonisiweyo
Izithuthi zihlala zinelungelo lokudlula kuqala kunabahambi ngeenyawo
Abahambi ngeenyawo abavumelekanga ukungena kuloo ndawo
xh.explanation: Uphawu lweNgqwalaselo yabaHambi ngeenyawo lunika abahambi ngeenyawo ilungelo lokuqala kwindawo ebonisiweyo kwaye luthintela ukufikelela kwezithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Yield to oncoming traffic sign R6

en.question: What must you do at a Yield to Oncoming Traffic sign?
options: Give right of way to oncoming traffic and proceed only when it is safe
Proceed first because your side has priority
Stop permanently and do not continue
en.explanation: This sign requires you to yield to oncoming traffic and proceed only when it is safe to enter the shared section of road.

af.question: Wat moet jy by 'n Gee Pad aan Aankomende Verkeer-teken doen?
options: Gee voorrang aan aankomende verkeer en gaan slegs voort wanneer dit veilig is
Gaan eerste omdat jou kant voorrang het
Stop permanent en moenie verder ry nie
af.explanation: Hierdie teken vereis dat jy aan aankomende verkeer voorrang gee en slegs voortgaan wanneer dit veilig is om die gedeelde padgedeelte binne te gaan.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kuphawu oluthi Nika indlela kwizithuthi eziza ngaphambili?
options: Nika izithuthi eziza ngaphambili ilungelo lokudlula uze uqhubeke kuphela xa kukhuselekile
Qhubeka kuqala kuba icala lakho linelungelo lokuqala
Yima ngokusisigxina ungaphindi uqhubeke
xh.explanation: Olu phawu lufuna ukuba unike indlela kwizithuthi eziza ngaphambili uze ungene kuphela xa kukhuselekile kwinxalenye yendlela esetyenziswa macala omabini.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Pedestrians prohibited R218/TR218

en.question: What does a Pedestrians Prohibited sign mean?
options: Pedestrians may not enter or cross where the restriction applies
Pedestrians have priority over all vehicles
Only schoolchildren may cross there
en.explanation: This sign prohibits pedestrians from entering or crossing the road or path where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Voetgangers Verbode-teken?
options: Voetgangers mag nie ingaan of oorsteek waar die beperking geld nie
Voetgangers het voorrang bo alle voertuie
Slegs skoolkinders mag daar oorsteek
af.explanation: Hierdie teken verbied voetgangers om die pad of paadjie binne te gaan of oor te steek waar die beperking geld.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi AbaHambi ngeenyawo Abavumelekanga?
options: Abahambi ngeenyawo abavumelekanga ukungena okanye ukuwela apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Abahambi ngeenyawo banokubaluleka kuqala kuzo zonke izithuthi
Ngabantwana besikolo kuphela abavumelekileyo ukuwela apho
xh.explanation: Olu phawu luthintela abahambi ngeenyawo ekungeneni okanye ekuweleni indlela okanye umzila apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Pedal cycles prohibited R219/TR219

en.question: What does a Pedal Cycles Prohibited sign mean?
options: Cyclists may not proceed beyond the sign and must use another route
Cyclists have priority over motor vehicles
Only motorcycles may use the lane
en.explanation: This sign prohibits pedal cyclists from using the road, lane or path where the restriction applies.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Trapfietse Verbode-teken?
options: Fietsryers mag nie verby die teken gaan nie en moet 'n ander roete gebruik
Fietsryers het voorrang bo motorvoertuie
Slegs motorfietse mag die baan gebruik
af.explanation: Hierdie teken verbied trapfietsryers om die pad, baan of paadjie te gebruik waar die beperking geld.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Iibhayisekile Azivumelekanga?
options: Abakhweli beebhayisekile abavumelekanga ukudlula kophawu kwaye kufuneka basebenzise enye indlela
Abakhweli beebhayisekile banokubaluleka kuqala kwizithuthi
Ziithuthuthu kuphela ezinokusebenzisa umzila
xh.explanation: Olu phawu luthintela abakhweli beebhayisekile ekusebenziseni indlela, umzila okanye indlela encinci apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Road Traffic Signs — Motorcycles prohibited R222/TR222

en.question: What does a Motorcycles Prohibited sign mean?
options: Motorcycles may not enter the part of the road where the restriction applies
Motorcycles must use that road
Motorcycles may enter only at night
en.explanation: This sign prohibits motorcycles from entering the indicated part of the carriageway or road.

af.question: Wat beteken 'n Motorfietse Verbode-teken?
options: Motorfietse mag nie die deel van die pad binnegaan waar die beperking geld nie
Motorfietse moet daardie pad gebruik
Motorfietse mag slegs snags ingaan
af.explanation: Hierdie teken verbied motorfietse om die aangeduide deel van die rybaan of pad binne te gaan.

xh.question: Lithetha ntoni uphawu oluthi Izithuthuthu Azivumelekanga?
options: Izithuthuthu azivumelekanga ukungena kwinxalenye yendlela apho olo thintelo lusebenza khona
Izithuthuthu kufuneka zisebenzise loo ndlela
Izithuthuthu zingangena kuphela ebusuku
xh.explanation: Olu phawu luthintela izithuthuthu ekungeneni kwinxalenye ebonisiweyo yendlela.
